meta.name: azure-validate
meta.description: Pre-deployment validation for Azure readiness. Run deep checks on configuration, infrastructure (Bicep or Terraform), RBAC role assignments, managed identity permissions, and prerequisites before deploying. WHEN: validate my app, check deployment readiness, run preflight checks, verify configuration, check if ready to deploy, validate azure.yaml, validate Bicep, test before deploying, troubleshoot deployment errors, validate Azure Functions, validate function app, validate serverless deployment, verify RBAC roles, check role assignments, review managed identity permissions, what-if analysis, validate Container Apps deployment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在部署到 Azure 之前,先把配置、权限和基础设施问题查出来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发布到 Azure 前都想先确认配置和权限没坑
copy.tagline_en: Catch Azure configuration, permission, and infrastructure problems before you deploy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm Azure config and permissions are sound before every deploy

howto.what: 在部署 Azure 应用前,Claude 会按脚本逐项做上线前检查:配置、Bicep 或 Terraform 基础设施、RBAC 角色分配、托管身份权限与前置条件,并把进度写进 .azure/validate-status.json。
howto.when: 当你要求验证配置、检查部署是否就绪或排查部署错误时触发;它只在前置的 azure-prepare 已产出状态为 Approved 的部署计划后运行,位于 azure-deploy 之前。

say.text: 帮我做上线前检查,看看现在能不能部署
say.note: 脚本会逐项跑验证并记录进度

say.text: 验证一下 azure.yaml 和 Bicep 配置有没有问题
say.note: 检查会指出配置与基础设施的问题

say.text: 检查这个应用的 RBAC 角色分配和托管身份权限
say.note: 部署前核对角色与权限

howto.what_en: Before deploying to Azure, Claude runs a preflight check: configuration, Bicep or Terraform infrastructure, RBAC role assignments, managed identity permissions, and prerequisites, recording progress in .azure/validate-status.json.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to validate configuration, check deployment readiness, or troubleshoot deployment errors. It runs after azure-prepare produced an Approved deployment plan, and before azure-deploy.

say_en.text: Run preflight checks and tell me if this app is ready to deploy
say_en.note: The script walks through each check and records progress.

say_en.text: Validate my azure.yaml and Bicep configuration
say_en.note: Reports issues found in config and infrastructure.

say_en.text: Check the RBAC role assignments and managed identity permissions
say_en.note: Verifies roles and permissions before deploy.
